kind: comparability tolerance for our own lens's final_identity_distance
status: COMMITTED IN R-1, APPLIED AS A GATE IN R-2

external_distribution.note_on_the_count: the operator's prompt referred to 39 models; the pinned revision publishes 37 convergence traces, and 37 is what was actually used. The discrepancy is recorded rather than rounded to the expected number.
external_distribution.extraction: the identity_distance column of the final data row, located by column NAME rather than by index so an upstream column reordering cannot silently yield the wrong quantity
external_distribution.span_of_the_sweep: roughly 70M to 70B parameters across gemma, qwen, llama, olmo, pythia, gpt-oss and gpt2 families

a_fact_worth_recording.statement: The positive control's final_identity_distance, 0.578094, is EXACTLY the median of the external distribution.
a_fact_worth_recording.why_it_matters: the reference model against which our lens is compared sits at the centre of the external experience rather than at an extreme, which is the most favourable possible position for a reference

the_tolerance.primary_rule: Tukey inner fence on the external distribution

honest_statement_about_its_power.observation: because the raw lower fence is negative, the primary rule is NON-BINDING BELOW. As a one-sided test it can only catch a lens whose Jacobian is unusually FAR from the identity; it cannot catch one that is unusually CLOSE to it.
honest_statement_about_its_power.why_that_gap_matters: an identity distance near zero would mean J has degenerated towards the identity, which is to say the Jacobian lens has collapsed into an ordinary logit lens. That is a real failure mode and the primary rule would not detect it.

secondary_lower_gate.source: the minimum observed anywhere in the external sweep of 37 models
secondary_lower_gate.rule: a value below this is outside the range any real fitted lens in the external sweep attained, and is treated as outside the external distribution
secondary_lower_gate.registered_separately_so_its_weaker_basi: a single observed minimum is a less robust bound than a quantile fence, and it is labelled as such rather than presented as equivalent

how_it_is_applied.on_failure: stop and report; do not proceed to interpret any band
how_it_is_applied.why_it_gates: if our lens is not comparable to the external ones, then agreement or disagreement of any band derived from it carries no weight, and reading the band first would be interpreting a number whose basis had not been established
how_it_is_applied.our_value_is_not_yet_known: computing it requires reading lens_A, which OD-012 forbids until the convention is committed

what_this_tolerance_is_not: it is not a quality threshold for the lens
it is not evidence about any band
passing it does not make our lens correct, only comparable
claim_ceiling: A comparability tolerance. It licenses no claim of any kind.
